text_block_list.text:
I have a major objective in the Milers 
Cup.

First, secure a solid win today to hone my 
instincts for mile races. And then, where 
Sakura Bakushin O awaits—
choice_data_list:
Let's prepare thoroughly for the Yasuda 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm sure Bakushin O-chan is watching 
too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day, when I decided to 
make the mile my focus—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Shining brightly right here is what I've 
been aiming for.

In fact, thanks to the sheer speed North 
Flight demonstrated in the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen... she's drawing immense attention 
heading into today's race.
choice_data_list:
Let's show off your natural talent to the 
fullest!

Let's show off your raw talent to the 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
With light, graceful steps, I'll go don 
the mantle of victory!
